title: Users and roles
none: No users yet: the server accepts connections without authentication.

customRoles.title: Custom roles
customRoles.none: No custom roles. Built-in roles cover most needs; a custom role grants exactly the actions you choose.
customRoles.dropBody: Users that have it lose its privileges. This cannot be undone.

roleDialog.createDescription: A role on admin can apply to every database and the cluster; on another database, only to that database.
roleDialog.editDescription: The privileges and inherited roles replace the current ones. The role belongs to {{db}}.
roleDialog.name: Role name
roleDialog.privilegesHint: Leave the database or collection empty for every one. Privileges without actions are left out.

dialog.createDescription: The user authenticates against the chosen database (admin for users of the whole deployment).
dialog.editDescription: The roles replace the current ones. The user authenticates against {{db}}.
dialog.name: User name
dialog.passwordHint: Generated randomly. Copy it now: it cannot be read back later.
dialog.rolesHint: For example read or readWrite on one database, readAnyDatabase on admin.

password.title: New password for {{name}}
password.description: A random password is filled in; it is copied to the clipboard when saved.
password.changed: Password of {{name}} changed and copied to the clipboard.

drop.title: Delete the user {{name}}?
drop.body: Applications using this user can no longer connect. This cannot be undone.
